outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a plot.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on each bar for the n=4 replicates per group.
Tumor volume plot displays individual mouse data points as dots with mean and 95% CI error bars overlaid.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression (shRNA) shows individual data points overlaid on each bar for the n=4 replicates per group.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points as overlaying them would reduce readability.
Bar chart quantifying CD4 intensity shows individual data points (dots) for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars.
Bar chart quantifying pERK intensity shows individual data points (dots) for each field overlaid on the bars.
